summary: Raphael Pharmaceutical Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Annual Managed Services Proposal and Agreement with AIcreatesAI Inc., effective July 30, 2026. AIcreatesAI will serve as the company's managed AI transformation and growth operations partner for a twelve-month term, with a $180,000 annual fee payable monthly at $15,000. Unpaid invoices may become deferred obligations payable upon receipt of financing or other resources, potentially settled via common stock issuance with consent. The agreement also contemplates a token platform with a 2% net-profits share to AIcreatesAI. This is an ordinary service contract, not a special situation.
